text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I was once again unable to escape the wicked storm-force wind… and this is the outcome.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: What must I do to stir a wind that seizes victory?
choice_data_list: Don't worry—the wind's blowing in a promising direction.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: What must I do to stir a wind that seizes victory?
choice_data_list: Don't worry—the wind's blowing in a promising direction.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
choice_data_list: If we keep pushing forward, we'll achieve good results!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The wind is fickle. There's no telling when or on whom it will blow…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: But yes. I'm sure a favorable wind will blow next time.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: In fact, I will bring that wind myself!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: You're right… My apologies. I let my doubts take me there.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The wind blows for those who will it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I will endeavor to believe in myself a little more. And next time, I will whip up my own wind!
